_comment: Shoumik's movement numbers (metres, seconds), body colours (from docs/CHARACTER.md), animation timings and what his fists do. Clothes are in data/outfits.json. spawn = which road crossing he starts at (col/row of the grid, see data/world.json).

model._comment: Body colours and proportions. torsoWidthScale 1.15 = stocky. face = how the photo texture (assets/shoumik/face.png) is used: size in pixels (small = PS2 look), feather = how wide the soft edge is (0-1), toneMatch = how strongly the photo's skin tone is pulled towards 'skin' (0-1), brightness = extra lightening, cheekWidth = share of the image width between the two cheeks, chinY = how far down the image the chin is (0-1). Change the last two if the photo is replaced.

glb._comment: Real 3D Shoumik (assets/shoumik/shoumik.glb, built from the owner's Mixamo files). useOn = quality levels that load it (others use the code-built model; takes effect after a reload). height in metres; nativeHeight = height of the file. clips = which clip plays for each movement; idle is his signature arms-crossed pose. speeds: game speeds (walk/run/sprint, m/s) and the natural speed of each clip (walkClip/runClip/sprintClip) so feet do not slide. actions = clip for each animator action (loop = repeats; variants = picked by the action's variant number). jumpHoldAt = seconds into the jump clip used as the in-air pose; fallAfterSpeed = falling faster than this (m/s) switches to the fall clip. brightness multiplies the texture colours (lower = darker; his beige trousers glare in strong sun above ~0.9).

animation._comment: idleCrossAfterSeconds = how long he stands still before folding his arms (signature pose). runAtSpeed = speed (m/s) at which the run animation is at full stretch.

actions._comment: punch: duration of the swing, hitAt = seconds into the swing when it lands, range in metres, arcDegrees = how wide in front of him it reaches, moveFactor = how much he can still move while punching. hit = what happens when somebody punches him. lockMovement = animations during which the stick does nothing; cancelOnMove = animations that stop when the stick is pushed.

debugAnimKeys._comment: Only with ?debug=1: number keys play an animation on Shoumik so every animation can be checked.
